args.text: olefile 0.47 official API: isOleFile tests OLE signature; OleFileIO defaults to read-only and can be a context manager. raise_defects=olefile.DEFECT_INCORRECT raises malformed-container issues; parsing_issues retains nonfatal issues. listdir returns stream paths; get_size returns stream byte size; openstream returns BytesIO. Write mode is only enabled explicitly.
